# funnel_data_source (Data Source)

Reads an existing Funnel data source. Use it to copy a data source to another workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copy a data source from one workspace to another
data "funnel_data_source" "source" {
  workspace = var.source_workspace_id
  id        = var.source_data_source_id
}

resource "funnel_data_source" "copy" {
  workspace     = var.target_workspace_id
  type          = data.funnel_data_source.source.type
  name          = data.funnel_data_source.source.name
  template_id   = data.funnel_data_source.source.template_id
  credential_id = data.funnel_data_source.source.credential_id
  remote_id     = data.funnel_data_source.source.remote_id
  remote_struct = data.funnel_data_source.source.remote_struct
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Data source ID
- `workspace` (String) Funnel workspace ID the data source belongs to

### Read-Only

- `credential_id` (String) ID of the credential used to authenticate with the platform. Null if not set.
- `download_disabled` (Boolean) Whether downloading data from the source is paused
- `exclude_data_from_funnel` (Boolean) Whether the data is excluded from Funnel aggregations and queries
- `is_demo` (Boolean) Whether the data source produces demo data
- `name` (String) Data source name
- `remote_id` (String) Account or entity ID in the source platform. Null if not set.
- `remote_struct` (String) JSON-encoded remote identity fields. Null if not set.
- `state` (String) Current state of the data source, e.g. `OK` or `UNAUTHORIZED`
- `template_id` (String) Template ID that defines what data to collect. Null if not set.
- `type` (String) Source type identifier, e.g. `adwords` (Google Ads)
